$comment: Classifies every tracked Markdown file as current authority, stable reference, historical evidence, or explicitly out of scope. Keep sweep=true only for documents that genuinely need revisiting on every migration. See scripts/check-documentation-authorities.mjs and docs/ops/documentation-authorities.md.

authorities.why: Stable repository/task router. Moving contracts and hosted state belong in NOW.md, machine records and current-status.md.
Stable Claude-specific router. It links to task authorities instead of carrying a moving implementation history.
Operational reference for the private AI Lab package; it does not own repository or hosted contract position.
Detailed active/parked inventory; delivered and outstanding dispositions can move with a migration.
Execution sequence; a migration can complete or reorder an executable step.
Detailed live implementation and hosted-status authority.
Operational migration inventory and hosted-applied-state reference.
Current feature/safeguard classification; migrations can add features or move rule implementation.
ADR index carries implementation status per decision.
Legacy/current-production UI index. Moving repository state and migration history are deliberately excluded.
Retained legacy production UI direction/delivery reference. It is no longer a migration sweep or vNext authority.
Component-level authority for current production surfaces; it names no moving repository contract state.
Retained legacy target-design reference at its authored snapshot; not current-state authority.
Retained legacy delivery reference whose contract mentions identify what built individual steps.
Current implementation relationships between competitions, games and membership.
Programme phases and product gates that are not restated elsewhere; not every migration affects them.
Stage A-L engineering plan whose stage exit evidence can move, but not on every migration.

Vulnerability reporting policy; no project moving state.

authorityDirectories.why: Task-scoped outcome and delivery specifications; they link to canonical authorities and do not own moving repository or hosted state.
Spec Kit process metadata and engineering constitution; never a second moving product/contract authority.
Discoverable task-specific Agent Skills that route to existing authorities.
Project-scoped OpenCode agent role and permission instructions. They route work through existing repository authorities and never own moving product or hosted state.

Project-scoped Claude Code agent role and permission instructions, ported from the OpenCode definitions above. They route work through existing repository authorities and never own moving product or hosted state; their enforceable Bash policy lives in .claude/hooks/agent-bash-allow.json, not in the prose.
Decision records; docs/adr/README.md is listed separately because its index carries live implementation status.
Subsystem and programme references; exact live/structural entries override this directory default.
Repeatable operational procedures; exact live entries and docs/ops/records evidence override this default.
Quality governance/references; exact live/disposition entries and dated evidence subdirectories override this default.
Legacy/current production design references. Moving state and vNext direction live elsewhere.
Stable product-direction/reference documents; implementation and hosted state remain in their own authorities.

PR body form; it states no project fact.
